title: Mining Projects Register
body: Projects with no date, no owner, or two different targets drift without anyone noticing. At ADW, Go-Line and the A&U training are both past their end dates with nothing started, and the 2026 target still reads 20 Mt on one page and 21 Mt on another.
keyPoints: A target only counts once it's settled in one place. Until Peter confirms whether 2026 is 20 Mt or 21 Mt, don't quote either figure to Maaden or use it for a year-end gap.

Every open item needs a date and an owner. Go-Line's four tasks are unstarted past their Sep 30 end date, and all eight A&U training days are still Not started past Sep 22. If a task has slipped past its end date, reset it today or call it dropped.

Get the decision on record. Stage 6 Early Start is worth about 333,000 t a month, but Notion has no decision, and the recommendation task is still open. Whatever gets approved needs a compliant second egress, a 10% ramp gradient (12% temporary), and catchment and berms in place before a bench opens.
apply: The fuel bay had no power on Oct 1 and trucks were sent to the North Go-Line point. Expect fueling delays and queuing at shift change until the second container and the traffic change at that point are actually in place.
